name: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks 2025

consolidated: A06:2021 - Vulnerable and Outdated Components expanded into A03:2025 - Software Supply Chain Failures
A10:2021 - SSRF rolled into A01:2025 - Broken Access Control
renamed: A07:2021 - Identification and Authentication Failures is now A07:2025 - Authentication Failures
A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures is now A08:2025 - Software or Data Integrity Failures
A09:2021 - Security Logging and Monitoring Failures is now A09:2025 - Security Logging and Alerting Failures
reordered: A05:2021 - Security Misconfiguration moved up to A02:2025
A02:2021 - Cryptographic Failures moved down to A04:2025
A03:2021 - Injection moved down to A05:2025
A04:2021 - Insecure Design moved down to A06:2025
changelog.methodology: Community survey input + expanded data analysis over 589 CWEs; 248 CWEs across the 10 categories

risks.name: Broken Access Control
risks.description: Access control enforces policy such that users cannot act outside of their intended permissions. Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) has been rolled into this category for 2025.
detection_patterns: Bypassing access control checks by modifying URL
prevention: Deny by default except for public resources
Implement access control mechanisms once, reuse throughout
Log and alert access control failures
Validate and sanitize URLs for SSRF prevention

risks.name: Security Misconfiguration
risks.description: A system, application, or cloud service is set up incorrectly from a security perspective, creating vulnerabilities
detection_patterns: Insecure application server, framework, or library settings
Cloud misconfigurations (open object storage, permissive IAM)
prevention: Federated identity or short-lived credentials instead of embedded static keys

risks.name: Software Supply Chain Failures
risks.description: Compromises within or across the ecosystem of software dependencies, build systems, and distribution infrastructure
detection_patterns: Outdated or unmaintained components with known vulnerabilities
prevention: Use SLSA framework for build integrity

references.note: Expansion of A06:2021 - Vulnerable and Outdated Components, which no longer exists as a separate category

risks.name: Cryptographic Failures
risks.description: Failures related to the lack of cryptography, insufficiently strong cryptography, and leaking of cryptographic keys
detection_patterns: Data transmitted in clear text (HTTP, SMTP, FTP)
Old or weak cryptographic algorithms (MD5, SHA1, DES)
prevention: Encrypt all sensitive data at rest
Seed random values from a cryptographically secure source

risks.name: Injection
risks.description: Hostile data sent to an interpreter as part of a command or query
detection_patterns: Hostile data used in ORM search parameters
Direct concatenation into SQL, OS commands, LDAP
prevention: Escape special characters for residual dynamic queries
Use LIMIT to prevent mass disclosure in SQL injection

risks.name: Insecure Design
risks.description: Missing or ineffective control design; different from implementation bugs
detection_patterns: Missing rate limiting on sensitive operations
prevention: Use threat modeling for critical flows
Integrate security language in user stories
Use abuse cases alongside use cases

risks.name: Authentication Failures
risks.description: Confirmation of user identity, authentication, and session management
prevention: Weak password checks against breached password lists
Server-side session management with secure session IDs

risks.name: Software or Data Integrity Failures
risks.renamed_from: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
risks.description: Failure to maintain trust boundaries and verify the integrity of software, code, and data artifacts, at a lower level than Software Supply Chain Failures
detection_patterns: Untrusted client-side data trusted server-side (cookies, hidden fields)
Search path or library loading from an untrusted location
prevention: Verify digital signatures on software and updates
Reject native deserialization of untrusted data
Sign and verify build artefacts and configuration
Review code and configuration changes before promotion
Enforce integrity checks on trust boundaries

risks.name: Security Logging and Alerting Failures
risks.renamed_from: A09:2021 - Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
risks.description: Insufficient logging, alerting, and active response; logging without alerting has minimal value for identifying incidents
prevention: Log all login, access control, input validation failures
Log with sufficient context for forensics
Alert on relevant logging events, not just collect them

risks.name: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
risks.description: Improper error handling, logical errors, failing open, and other scenarios stemming from abnormal conditions
prevention: Generic error messages to users (detailed logs internal)

mapping_to_cwe_top_25.note: CWE Top 25 (2025) members that fall in each OWASP Top 10:2025 category

unmapped_top_25.reason: Memory-safety and resource-exhaustion weaknesses are not mapped into any OWASP Top 10:2025 category; agents MUST report these against the CWE Top 25 alone
